attributes.name: Coat of Mist
attributes.powers:
If you have the Druid, Hunter, Ranger, or Shifter trait, recharge this card to evade a monster you encounter. 

Recharge this card to reduce Combat or Electricity damage dealt to you by 2. 

Banish this card to reduce all damage dealt to you to 0. If proficient with light armors, bury it instead.
